20261121-physics-e4-1.s.s1.prompt: A gwajin daidaitawa, an rataye nauyin 10 g guda 2 a ratsi 3 a hagu na wurin dogaro. Nawa ne nauyin 10 g da ake buƙatar a rataye a ratsi 1 a dama don a daidaita?
20261121-physics-e4-1.s.s1.explain: Tasirin ƙarfi a hagu shine $3 \times 20\text{ g} = 60$. Tun da nisa a dama shine $1\text{ ratsi}$, nauyin da ake buƙata shine $60\text{ g}$, kuma ana buƙatar nauyi $6$ na $10\text{ g}$.
20261121-physics-e4-1.s.s1.hint.0: Jimillar nauyi a hagu 20 g ne kuma nisa ratsi 3 ne (3 × 20 = 60).
20261121-physics-e4-1.s.s1.hint.1: Tun da nisa a dama ratsi 1 ne, nauyin dole ya zama 60 g (nauyi guda 6).

20261121-physics-e4-2.goal: Apply principles of Menene dalilin kimiyya da ya sa to solve the reasoning problem.
20261121-physics-e4-2.material: Menene dalilin kimiyya da ya sa idan aka ja ƙusa da ya kafu sosai a katako da guduma mai ja (claw hammer) ta hanyar riƙe ƙarshen hannunta, ana amfani da ƙarfi ƙasa da idan an riƙe tsakiyar?
20261121-physics-e4-2.thinking.0: Menene dalilin kimiyya da ya sa
20261121-physics-e4-2.s.s1.prompt: Menene dalilin kimiyya da ya sa idan aka ja ƙusa da ya kafu sosai a katako da guduma mai ja (claw hammer) ta hanyar riƙe ƙarshen hannunta, ana amfani da ƙarfi ƙasa da idan an riƙe tsakiyar?
20261121-physics-e4-2.s.s1.explain: A cikin lever, idan nisa tsakanin wurin dogaro da wurin sa ƙarfi ya ƙaru, ana iya isar da babban ƙarfi zuwa wurin aiki da ƙaramin ƙarfi, don haka ana cire ƙusa cikin sauƙi.
20261121-physics-e4-2.s.s1.hint.0: Yi tunani game da ƙa'idar lever.
20261121-physics-e4-2.s.s1.hint.1: Idan nisa tsakanin wurin dogaro da wurin sa ƙarfi ya fi girma, ana iya samar da babban ƙarfi da ƙaramin ƙarfi.
20261121-physics-e4-2.s.s1.o.o0: Domin nisan daga wurin dogaro (lanƙwasar kan guduma) zuwa wurin da ake sa ƙarfi (hannu) yana ƙaruwa

20261122-physics-e4-1.title: Idan ana ɗaga babban dutse mai
20261122-physics-e4-1.topic: Idan ana ɗaga babban dutse mai
20261122-physics-e4-1.goal: Apply principles of Idan ana ɗaga babban dutse mai to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-e4-1.material: [Tunani mai zurfi] Idan ana ɗaga babban dutse mai nauyi da lever, idan aka sa wurin dogaro kusa da dutsen (wurin aiki), ƙarfin da ake danna da hannu yana raguwa, amma ta yaya tazarar da hannu dole ya sauka take canzawa?
20261122-physics-e4-1.thinking.0: Idan ana ɗaga babban dutse mai
20261122-physics-e4-1.s.s1.prompt: [Tunani mai zurfi] Idan ana ɗaga babban dutse mai nauyi da lever, idan aka sa wurin dogaro kusa da dutsen (wurin aiki), ƙarfin da ake danna da hannu yana raguwa, amma ta yaya tazarar da hannu dole ya sauka take canzawa?
20261122-physics-e4-1.s.s1.explain: Idan aka yi amfani da lever, ana iya rage girman ƙarfi, amma tazarar da hannu dole ya motsa tana ƙaruwa daidai gwargwado, don haka jimillar aikin da aka yi yana tabbatuwa (ƙa'idar aiki).
20261122-physics-e4-1.s.s1.hint.0: Idan an sami riba a ƙarfi lokacin amfani da lever, ana yin asara a tazarar motsi.
20261122-physics-e4-1.s.s1.hint.1: A kimiyyar lissafi ana kiran wannan 'ƙa'idar aiki'.
20261122-physics-e4-1.s.s1.o.o0: Tazarar da hannu dole ya motsa tana ƙaruwa
20261122-physics-e4-1.s.s1.o.o1: Tazarar da hannu dole ya motsa ma tana raguwa
20261122-physics-e4-1.s.s1.o.o2: Tazarar motsi ba ta canzawa ko kaɗan
20261122-physics-e4-1.s.s1.o.o3: Yana ɗagawa da kansa ba tare da motsa hannu ba

20261122-physics-e4-2.title: Menene dalilin da ya sa ake
20261122-physics-e4-2.topic: Menene dalilin da ya sa ake
20261122-physics-e4-2.goal: Apply principles of Menene dalilin da ya sa ake to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-e4-2.material: Menene dalilin da ya sa ake iya motsa kaya mai nauyi da ƙarancin ƙarfi idan aka ɗora shi a kan keken turawa mai ƙafafu fiye da idan aka ja shi a ƙasa kawai?
20261122-physics-e4-2.thinking.0: Menene dalilin da ya sa ake
20261122-physics-e4-2.s.s1.prompt: Menene dalilin da ya sa ake iya motsa kaya mai nauyi da ƙarancin ƙarfi idan aka ɗora shi a kan keken turawa mai ƙafafu fiye da idan aka ja shi a ƙasa kawai?
20261122-physics-e4-2.s.s1.explain: Idan aka yi amfani da ƙafafu, gogayyar zamewa tsakanin ƙasa da abu tana canzawa zuwa gogayyar mirginawa mai ƙanƙanta sosai, don haka ƙarfin gogayyar da ke hana motsi yana raguwa sosai.
20261122-physics-e4-2.s.s1.hint.0: Kwatanta girman gogayyar da ke faruwa lokacin da abu ke zamewa da gogayyar da ke faruwa lokacin da ƙafa ke mirginawa.
20261122-physics-e4-2.s.s1.hint.1: Gogayyar mirginawa ta ƙafa tana da ƙanƙanta sosai.
20261122-physics-e4-2.s.s1.o.o0: Domin yayin da ƙafafu ke mirginawa, 'ƙarfin gogayyar mirginawa' a wurin taɓawa yana yin ƙanƙanta fiye da gogayyar zamewa
20261122-physics-e4-2.s.s1.o.o1: Domin ƙafafu suna rage yawan kayan zuwa 1/10
20261122-physics-e4-2.s.s1.o.o2: Domin ƙarfin jan duniya yana ɓacewa a kan ƙafafu
20261122-physics-e4-2.s.s1.o.o3: Domin ƙasa tana tura ƙafafu gaba
